review: cleanup-part2 CP1 focused mathematical/API source review

findings.title: Read the uniform machine through its existing output/run contract, not a whole-machine body alias
findings.reason: The new theorem equates an NUPPT-valued definition with its complete defining expression and consumers rewrite the machine before accessing output. That is the expressly excluded machine-body-alias route, although the equation is mathematically true. Existing output_ofPolyTimeUniform (PPT:404), runAtL_ofPolyTimeUniform (PPT:426), and coin readers already expose the intended behavior.
findings.minimal_repair: In each cited simp list, replace NUPPT.ofPolyTimeUniform_def plus NUPPT.output_ofPolyTime by NUPPT.output_ofPolyTimeUniform; retain the surrounding runAt/runAtL and layout readers. Alternatively use runAtL_ofPolyTimeUniform before unfolding runAtL where appropriate. Remove the added alias once no uses remain. Check each existing proof separately, with the final required seal/scan, without changing machine data, premises or theorem headers.
findings.acceptance_effect: A concrete interface/route correction before treating milestone 1 interfaces as complete or making final acceptance claims; no claim that the mathematical security theorem is false.

reviewed_routes.reason: Original generic Type* construction copied exactly; flat index j+ell*i and inverse divNat/modNat retained. Bool forward aliases and GI inverse alias retain orientation. Window has original a+k<=L contract and only Bool codomain. q=0/ell=0/k=0 are handled without extra positivity/nonemptiness. Concrete castLE index retains j+B*t.

Shared iff is equality with the entire list, not a length-only or prefix condition. Existing false-tag query equation/true-two verdict equation plus new ofFn, wrong-length and default readers cover all words. Default excludes every false-tag pair and both verdict words; malformed query payloads are covered separately. At ell=0 the empty payload is a query and every nonempty query payload is rejected.

Acceptance-test stateFind remains distinct from fixed length-guarded round iteration. Fixed-round statement is the old type with authorized fullname/namespace spelling, below iterate in Repetition. GGM stateLoopFun complete data body and eval header are byte-identical to ancestor. GI/Encoding alias headers are unchanged; dlb specializes output to pairSndD. No upper import from Build/StateLoop is introduced.

Promotion matches old rabin_uexp_le full type modulo name/private and whitespace, including Type* source/codomain universes, Aux:gamma->Type, every Fintype/Nonempty Aux assumption, and unchanged additive delta. No Nonempty source/codomain added. The proof uses uniform coordinates of the dependent product; empty source behavior is preserved. RSA keeps exponent/challenge/adversary coins in the same dependent Aux; Rabin keeps domain/adversary coins and symmetric uses.

Lower generic theorem retains efficient-strategy premise and all four polynomial-time maps. reply_poly instantiates it, and old ColZK theorem remains an exact-header alias. Static mixed payload/ancestor reachability has no cycle; SimulatorMachine has no direct/transitive ColZKMachine import.

All seven explicit declaration types match ancestor; the subgroup implementation changes from record to the authorized powMonoidHom kernel. Finite Group proper-subgroup assumptions, p!=2, p%4=3/QR membership, Fact(1<N), prime factors and fmult exceptional-unit case remain. No p!=q/Nonempty/new general host is added. m=0 kernel gives top as before.

limits: No incoming program imported or executed.
No Lean/native/build/cache/app invocation; no Git mutations.
This does not reproduce patches, validate all payload hashes, prove native success or cover every declaration.
Header checks concern the explicit targets listed; source inspection includes the reported line ranges, not full security proof audits.
Finite arithmetic checks are independent sanity tests, not formal theorem checks.

No final/merge/gate ruling. CP1 explicitly remains partial; remaining inherited reads, axiom census, admission freeze, source freeze, patch reproduction, final controls/C3 and native results are separate review/acceptance work.

All 162 added headers in worker surface data were classified as theorem declarations; this is a metadata observation, not an independently elaborated complete declaration census. The 134 _def header scan isolated the machine alias finding, not a proof that all other J/N reads are closed.
No independent new textbook/paper source-access claim. Mathematical comparison is against the exact issued contract, ancestor source and supplied final source.
